points.label: Time and final consequence
points.left: A woman gives birth while a dragon waits. Her child is taken to God’s throne, and she flees into the wilderness. Michael and his angels fight the dragon and cast him out. The source names him as the old serpent, devil, Satan, deceiver, and accuser. Victory, a short time, pursuit, protection, a flood, the earth, and the woman’s offspring complete the vision.
points.right: An angel comes with a key and chain. He binds the dragon, who is also called the old serpent, devil, and Satan, and shuts him in the abyss. Thrones and the first resurrection follow. Satan is later released and deceives the nations. Their last gathering ends in fire, and the devil is thrown into the lake of fire.

payload.posture: Read both WEBU passages side by side. Keep each passage’s actors, setting, order, and identity claims distinct.

rightEvidence.title: The dragon is bound, released, deceives nations, and enters the lake of fire

payload.tension: Revelation gives the dragon more than one limit before his final judgment.
